svg.title: Tiling: make the working set fit
svg.text: Tiling: make the working set fit
compute a T×T block of C from T-wide strips of A and B, so each loaded element is reused T times
in uc these are rewrites on ranges: split r → (r_outer·T + r_inner), reorder, then
upcast the innermost to registers / SIMD lanes. The symbolic simplifier cleans up the indices.
